`289-306`: _📐 Maintainability & Code Quality_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Duplicated lazy-cache boilerplate across four methods.** The `if not hasattr(self, "_X_cache"): ... ; return self._X_cache` pattern is repeated near-identically four times. Extracting a small shared helper would reduce duplication and the chance that a future edit diverges from the others.
♻️ Example helper to reduce duplication ```diff + def _instance_cache(self, cache_attr: str, factory: Callable[[], Any]) -> Any: + if not hasattr(self, cache_attr): + setattr(self, cache_attr, factory()) + return getattr(self, cache_attr) + def _extract_input_output_types(self) -> tuple[type[Any], type[Any]]: - if not hasattr(self, "_extract_input_output_types_cache"): - # First try the signature-based approach - result = self._extract_types_from_signature_method() - if result: - self._extract_input_output_types_cache = result - return self._extract_input_output_types_cache - - # Fallback to MRO-based approach for complex inheritance - result = self._extract_instance_types_from_mro() - if result: - self._extract_input_output_types_cache = result - return self._extract_input_output_types_cache - - raise ValueError(...) - - return self._extract_input_output_types_cache + def _compute() -> tuple[type[Any], type[Any]]: + result = self._extract_types_from_signature_method() or self._extract_instance_types_from_mro() + if result is None: + raise ValueError(...) + return result + return self._instance_cache("_extract_input_output_types_cache", _compute) ```
Also applies to: 335-342, 441-455, 503-513
